purpose: Prove the minimal Plan -> Write -> Truth -> Product execution and artifact path without running a new Writer or reactivating legacy experiment scripts.

truth.note: Round-01 Truth was semantically over-approving; this stage only proves the boundary and provenance path.

limitations: No live agent is invoked in Phase 2 smoke mode.
Legacy Truth output is referenced but explicitly not trusted as a factual gate.
Guided owner review is diagnostic evidence, not blind calibration evidence.
No trace.jsonl or root-cause diagnosis is produced; that belongs to Phase 3.
